value.name: name
value.value: Video-FaceSwap Detector
value.description: Name of the model.

value.name: description
value.value: This model is designed for Video Deepfake Detection tasks, specialized in detecting face-swap and face-reenactment manipulations, not fully AI-generated videos. It focuses on the participants faces and by utilizing only the vision stream of the video (not the audio) determines whether a person’s face has been replaced or manipulated within the video.
value.description: Model introduction, purpose, capabilities, novelty and caveats.
